title: Convert center-of-mass compliance into an inverse-cubic passband moment
statement: For a connected positive finite internal spring graph with one intercell link, C_CM=w^T D0^+ w is independent of Bloch wave number. Its spectral passband satisfies integral(1_[0,Omega]-chi)/omega^3=ms^2 C_CM/(2M). This supplies a third exact moment for constrained spectrum design.

requires: backbone and side masses with M>m
assumptions: Gibbs variance consequence only in equilibrium
costs: finite spectral computation; no solution to the three-moment extremal problem is claimed
contract.units: C_CM has time^2/mass; signed moment has time^2
contract.obstruction: Makes displacement constraints usable in band design; does not transfer to multichannel/vector or nonequilibrium materials.

evidence.quote: Thus compliance is a THIRD exact moment constraint

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
